files.html: //! input_gamepad - the gamepads the platform reads, one panel per slot: each button lit while held, both sticks as a //! dot inside their circle, and the triggers as bars filling with their travel. Pressing the south button - A on an //! Xbox pad, cross on a PlayStation one - rumbles that gamepad for a quarter of a second. A browser shows a page its //! gamepads only once a button is pressed while the page has the focus. const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const z = @import("zimr"); const zm = @import("zm"); const Color = zm.Color; const Vec2 = zm.Vec2; const float = zm.float; const State = struct { font: z.Font, }; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); const background: Color = .{ .r = 24, .g = 26, .b = 34, .a = 255 }; const panel: Color = .{ .r = 36, .g = 40, .b = 52, .a = 255 }; const resting: Color = .{ .r = 70, .g = 76, .b = 92, .a = 255 }; const held: Color = .{ .r = 96, .g = 165, .b = 250, .a = 255 }; const text_color: Color = .{ .r = 230, .g = 230, .b = 235, .a = 255 }; /// The buttons a panel shows, by raylib's names, with the labels an Xbox pad prints. const shown_buttons = [_]struct { button: z.GamepadButton, label: []const u8 }{ .{ .button = .right_face_down, .label = "A" }, .{ .button = .right_face_right, .label = "B" }, .{ .button = .right_face_left, .label = "X" }, .{ .button = .right_face_up, .label = "Y" }, .{ .button = .left_trigger_1, .label = "LB" }, .{ .button = .right_trigger_1, .label = "RB" }, .{ .button = .middle_left, .label = "Back" }, .{ .button = .middle_right, .label = "Start" }, .{ .button = .left_thumb, .label = "LS" }, .{ .button = .right_thumb, .label = "RS" }, .{ .button = .left_face_up, .label = "Up" }, .{ .button = .left_face_down, .label = "Down" }, .{ .button = .left_face_left, .label = "Left" }, .{ .button = .left_face_right, .label = "Right" }, }; fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { const font: z.Font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 16); s.* = .{ .font = font }; } /// A stick: its circle, and a dot where the stick points. fn drawStick(f: *z.Frame, center: Vec2, x: f32, y: f32) void { const radius: f32 = 34; f.gl.circle(center, radius, .{ .color = resting, .segments = 32 }); const tip: Vec2 = .{ center[0] + x * radius, center[1] + y * radius }; f.gl.circle(tip, 8, .{ .color = held, .segments = 16 }); } /// A trigger: a bar filling upward with its travel, 0 to 1. fn drawTrigger( f: *z.Frame, s: *State, corner: Vec2, travel: f32, label: []const u8, ) void { const height: f32 = 70; f.gl.rect(.{ .x = corner[0], .y = corner[1], .width = 22, .height = height }, .{ .color = resting }); const filled: f32 = height * travel; f.gl.rect(.{ .x = corner[0], .y = corner[1] + height - filled, .width = 22, .height = filled }, .{ .color = held }); f.gl.text(.{ corner[0], corner[1] + height + 4 }, label, .{ .size = 14, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); } /// One slot's panel at `corner`: its buttons, sticks and triggers. Its south button rumbles it. fn drawGamepad(f: *z.Frame, s: *State, slot: i32, corner: Vec2) void { f.gl.rect(.{ .x = corner[0], .y = corner[1], .width = 440, .height = 230 }, .{ .color = panel }); f.gl.textf( .{ corner[0] + 12, corner[1] + 8 }, "gamepad {d}", .{slot}, .{ .size = 16, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }, ); for (shown_buttons, 0..) |shown, index| { const column: f32 = float(index % 7); const row: f32 = float(index / 7); const box_x: f32 = corner[0] + 12 + column * 60; const box_y: f32 = corner[1] + 36 + row * 34; const is_held: bool = z.isGamepadButtonDown(f.input, slot, shown.button); const box_color: Color = if (is_held) held else resting; f.gl.rect(.{ .x = box_x, .y = box_y, .width = 54, .height = 28 }, .{ .color = box_color }); f.gl.text(.{ box_x + 6, box_y + 6 }, shown.label, .{ .size = 14, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); } const left_x: f32 = z.getGamepadAxisMovement(f.input, slot, .left_x); const left_y: f32 = z.getGamepadAxisMovement(f.input, slot, .left_y); const right_x: f32 = z.getGamepadAxisMovement(f.input, slot, .right_x); const right_y: f32 = z.getGamepadAxisMovement(f.input, slot, .right_y); drawStick(f, .{ corner[0] + 60, corner[1] + 160 }, left_x, left_y); drawStick(f, .{ corner[0] + 160, corner[1] + 160 }, right_x, right_y); const left_trigger: f32 = z.getGamepadAxisMovement(f.input, slot, .left_trigger); const right_trigger: f32 = z.getGamepadAxisMovement(f.input, slot, .right_trigger); drawTrigger(f, s, .{ corner[0] + 240, corner[1] + 112 }, left_trigger, "LT"); drawTrigger(f, s, .{ corner[0] + 280, corner[1] + 112 }, right_trigger, "RT"); if (z.isGamepadButtonPressed(f.input, slot, .right_face_down)) { z.setGamepadVibration(f.input, slot, 0.6, 0.4, 0.25); } } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { z.clearViewport(f, background); var shown_count: u32 = 0; var slot: i32 = 0; while (slot < 4) : (slot += 1) { if (!z.isGamepadAvailable(f.input, slot)) { continue; } const column: f32 = float(shown_count % 2); const row: f32 = float(shown_count / 2); drawGamepad(f, s, slot, .{ 16 + column * 456, 16 + row * 246 }); shown_count += 1; } if (shown_count == 0) { const prompt: []const u8 = "connect a gamepad, then press one of its buttons"; f.gl.text(.{ 24, 24 }, prompt, .{ .size = 18, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); } } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - gamepads", .width = 928, .height = 508, .scale_mode = .responsive, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, };
